concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-account-sales-day-payout]] — 2026-09-15 Adyen Sales day payout model guide: local-time-zone sales-day cutoff, delay to payable-batch assignment, regional and method-mix limits, adjustments, two-hour batch close, bank instruction, and holiday effects; it does not prove bank receipt.
warnings: Apply after the upgrade worker's proposed Adyen Sales day payout concept is accepted; do not create a competing concept.
Sales Day Payout merchant settlement is distinct from the legacy outbound Payout API.
The page says batches close according to payout frequency (line 37) and also two hours after sales-day closing time (line 126); do not infer a non-daily close schedule from these statements.
